sourceBindings.fact: Each makeArchiveCache allocates writesSincePrune at zero. Only write increments; every fourth successful eligible write invokes automatic prune. The new span/annotations execute inside prune only.
writeOptions.prune=false skips the counter. Otherwise next=(count+1)%4 and prune executes only at zero; fewer than four total write observations is sufficient to exclude it.
Cache miss fetches the archive and writes it once. Cache hits do not write or increment the counter.
Archive cache and pruning state belong to the invocation and are shared by its remote registry clients.
Only cache prune explicitly invokes public cache.prune(); bare cache is a command group with no handler.
Completed registry cases and installed typed skill routes select one-extension fixtures; larger scaling cases are separate IDs. Explicit prune is installed/cache-prune, absent from the completed 52.
Handoff fixture points to a local skill source and has no registry acquisition or explicit prune.
Child environment disables startup refresh/telemetry. Preparation and measured products each call runObservedProcess separately.
runObservedProcess spawns a fresh child process, so fixture-preparation writes cannot carry the in-memory prune counter into a product invocation.
